🪷 Product Highlights:

Design: Traditional forms of women, animals, or mythical figures

Made without molds – each piece is one-of-a-kind

🌾 Tepa Putul isn’t just a toy – it’s a piece of history molded by hand and heart.

fields.question: What is RootReach?
fields.answer: RootReach is an e-commerce marketplace that connects buyers and sellers. We provide a platform for buying and selling products with secure payments, reliable shipping, and buyer protection.

fields.question: How do I create an account?
fields.answer: Click "Sign Up" or "Register" on the homepage. Fill in your email, create a password, and complete your profile. You'll be able to start shopping immediately!

fields.question: How do I become a seller?
fields.answer: Go to "Sell Zone" and click "Apply to Sell". Fill out the seller application with your shop details, business information, and verification documents. Our team will review and approve your application within 2-3 business days.
fields.keywords: seller, become seller, apply seller, how to sell

fields.question: How can I track my order?
fields.answer: Once you place an order, you can track it from your "Orders" page. You'll see the current status (pending, confirmed, shipped, or delivered) and estimated delivery date.
fields.keywords: order tracking, track order, where is my order

fields.question: What payment methods do you accept?
fields.answer: We accept multiple payment methods including credit cards, debit cards, mobile banking, and online payment gateways for your convenience and security.
fields.keywords: payment, pay, payment method, credit card, debit

fields.question: Is my payment secure?
fields.answer: Yes! All payments are encrypted and processed through secure payment gateways. Your financial information is protected with the latest security standards.

fields.question: How long does delivery take?
fields.answer: Delivery typically takes 3-7 business days depending on your location. Express shipping options may be available for an additional fee.

fields.question: Do you offer free shipping?
fields.answer: Free shipping is often available on orders above certain amounts. Check the specific product page or your cart to see shipping costs before checkout.
fields.keywords: free shipping, shipping cost, shipping fee

fields.question: Can I change my delivery address after placing an order?
fields.answer: Yes, if your order hasn't been shipped yet. Contact our support team immediately through the order details page to change your address.
fields.keywords: change address, delivery address, shipping address

fields.question: What is your return policy?
fields.answer: We offer a 30-day return guarantee. If you're not satisfied with your purchase, you can initiate a return within 30 days of delivery. The product must be in original condition.

fields.question: How do I process a return?
fields.answer: Go to your Orders page, find the product, and click "Return". Follow the return process, arrange pickup with our logistics partner, and your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days of receipt.
fields.keywords: return process, how to return, return steps

fields.question: How do I update my profile?
fields.answer: Click on your profile icon and select "Edit Profile". You can update your personal information, profile picture, address, and contact details.

fields.question: How do I reset my password?
fields.answer: Click "Forgot Password" on the login page. Enter your email and follow the instructions to reset your password. You'll receive a reset link in your email.

fields.question: How do I delete my account?
fields.answer: You can request account deletion from your account settings. Once deleted, your data cannot be recovered. Contact support if you have any questions.
fields.keywords: delete account, close account, remove account

fields.question: How do I search for products?
fields.answer: Use the search bar at the top of the page or browse by category. You can filter results by price, region, availability, and sort by various criteria.

fields.question: Can I compare products?
fields.answer: Yes! Add products to the comparison list and you'll be able to see side-by-side comparison of features, prices, and specifications.

fields.question: How do I leave a review?
fields.answer: After receiving your order, go to your Orders page and click "Leave Review" on the product. Rate the product and share your feedback to help other buyers.

fields.question: What do I need to become a seller?
fields.answer: You need an active account, valid business information, NID/tax ID, and a shop photo. Submit via the seller application and we'll verify your details.
fields.keywords: seller requirements, become seller, seller verification

fields.question: How do I manage my products as a seller?
fields.answer: Go to "Sell Zone" and use "Manage Products" to add, edit, or delete products. You can also track inventory, set prices, and manage discounts.
fields.keywords: manage products, seller dashboard, add product

fields.question: How do I respond to buyer messages?
fields.answer: Visit "Seller Messages" in your Sell Zone to see all buyer inquiries. Click on a message to respond directly to the buyer.

fields.question: Is there a customer service team available?
fields.answer: Yes! Our support team is available 24/7 through the contact form on each product page or order. We typically respond within 24 hours.

fields.question: What should I do if I have an issue with my order?
fields.answer: Contact the seller directly through the product messaging system first. If the issue isn't resolved, contact our support team for assistance.

fields.question: What is RootReach?
fields.answer: RootReach is Bangladesh's leading e-commerce marketplace connecting buyers and sellers. We provide secure payments, reliable shipping nationwide, quality-verified products, and buyer protection.
fields.keywords: what is rootreach, platform, marketplace, bangladesh

fields.question: How do I create an account?
fields.answer: Click "Sign Up" on the homepage. Enter your email, create a secure password, and complete your profile with your name and phone number. Instant account creation!

fields.question: How do I search for products?
fields.answer: Use the search bar on the homepage, browse by categories, or use our smart filters (price, rating, region, seller). You can also compare products side-by-side.

fields.question: How do I place an order?
fields.answer: Add products to cart, review items, enter delivery address, choose payment method, and click "Place Order". You'll get instant order confirmation with tracking number.

fields.question: Can I use a discount code?
fields.answer: Yes! Enter promotional codes at checkout if you have them. Check our promotions page for current offers and seasonal discounts.

fields.question: What if I forget my password?
fields.answer: Click "Forgot Password" on the login page. Enter your email and we'll send you a reset link. Create a new password and you're back in!

fields.question: Can I edit my order after placing it?
fields.answer: You can edit your order if the seller hasn't confirmed it yet. Go to Orders → select order → click Edit. Once confirmed, contact support.
fields.keywords: edit order, modify order, change order

fields.question: How do I contact the seller?
fields.answer: Click "Chat with Seller" on the product page or your order. You can ask questions, negotiate, or discuss issues directly with the seller.
fields.keywords: contact seller, message, chat, seller communication

fields.question: How do I leave a review?
fields.answer: After delivery, go to your order and click "Write Review". Rate the product (1-5 stars) and write your honest feedback. Reviews help other buyers!

fields.question: Can I cancel my order?
fields.answer: Yes, you can cancel before the seller confirms it. Go to Orders → select order → click Cancel. You'll get a full refund if payment was made.

fields.question: How do I become a seller?
fields.answer: Go to "Sell Zone" → "Apply to Sell". Fill your business details, bank info, and upload documents. Admin approval takes 2-3 business days. Start selling after approval!
fields.keywords: seller, become seller, apply seller, how to sell

fields.question: What documents do I need to become a seller?
fields.answer: You'll need: National ID, business registration (if applicable), bank account info, and store details. Documents should be clear and valid.

fields.question: How do I add products to my store?
fields.answer: Go to Sell Zone → Manage Products → Add Product. Fill in name, description, price, images, stock, and category. Click Save to publish. Instant listing!
fields.keywords: add product, list product, upload product

fields.question: What is the seller commission?
fields.answer: Commission varies by category (typically 5-15%). Exact amount is shown before you list. All fees are transparent in your dashboard.

fields.question: How are payments made to sellers?
fields.answer: After order delivery and 7-day buyer protection period, payment is transferred to your registered bank account. Transfers happen weekly or as per policy.

fields.question: How do I respond to buyer questions?
fields.answer: Go to Seller Zone → Messages. Respond quickly and professionally. Our AI can suggest helpful replies to save time!

fields.question: Can I increase my product price after listing?
fields.answer: Yes! Go to Manage Products → Edit → change price → Save. Price change takes effect immediately.
fields.keywords: change price, price update, edit price

fields.question: How do I handle low stock?
fields.answer: Update stock quantity in Manage Products. When stock reaches 0, listing becomes inactive. Restock anytime to reactivate.

fields.question: What happens if a buyer returns a product?
fields.answer: Buyer initiates return within 30 days. You'll be notified to accept/reject. Accept returns → buyer ships product → you inspect → refund issued or item relisted.
fields.keywords: return, refund, seller refund, return policy

fields.question: How can I improve my seller rating?
fields.answer: Respond quickly, ship on time, describe products accurately, package well, and provide great customer service. Positive reviews boost your rating!
fields.keywords: seller rating, reviews, rating up, improve rating

fields.question: What payment methods are accepted?
fields.answer: We accept: Credit/Debit Card, Mobile Banking (bKash, Nagad, Rocket), Bank Transfer, Wallet. Choose at checkout. All methods are secure.
fields.keywords: payment method, pay, credit card, mobile banking, bkash

fields.question: Is my payment information secure?
fields.answer: Absolutely! Payments use SSL encryption and PCI compliance. Your financial data is never stored on our servers. 100% secure.
fields.keywords: secure, safety, encryption, payment security, privacy

fields.question: What is your refund policy?
fields.answer: Refunds are issued within 5-7 business days of approval. Money is returned to original payment method. Seller return + inspection → admin approval → refund.

fields.question: Can I get an invoice?
fields.answer: Yes! You can download invoice from each order. Go to Orders → select order → Download Invoice. Includes all details for your records.

fields.question: What is the buyer protection period?
fields.answer: After delivery, you have 7 days to inspect and report issues. You can request return/refund during this time. After 7 days, seller keeps payment.

fields.question: Do you deliver nationwide?
fields.answer: Yes! We ship to all divisions: Dhaka, Chattogram, Khulna, Sylhet, Barishal, Rajshahi, Rangpur, and Mymensingh. Remote areas may take longer.

fields.question: How much does shipping cost?
fields.answer: Shipping costs vary by weight and location. Check at checkout before paying. Free shipping often available on orders over set amount.
fields.keywords: shipping cost, delivery fee, free shipping

fields.question: Can I track my order?
fields.answer: Yes! Go to Orders → Track to see real-time status. You'll see: Pending → Confirmed → Shipped → In Transit → Out for Delivery → Delivered.
fields.keywords: track order, tracking, order status, where is

fields.question: What if my order is delayed?
fields.answer: Check tracking for updates. If delayed beyond estimated date, contact support with order number. We'll investigate and compensate if our fault.

fields.question: Can I change my delivery address after ordering?
fields.answer: If not shipped yet, contact support immediately with new address. We'll try to update it. Once shipped, address cannot be changed.
fields.keywords: change address, delivery address, shipping address

fields.question: What if the item is damaged on delivery?
fields.answer: Don't accept the delivery or accept but report damage immediately. Contact support with photos. Initiate return under "Item Damaged" reason.

fields.question: What if I receive the wrong item?
fields.answer: Contact seller and support immediately with order number. We'll arrange return of wrong item and send correct one at no extra cost.

fields.question: What is the 30-day return policy?
fields.answer: Within 30 days of delivery, return any item in original condition with packaging. Inspect quality first. Return shipping cost varies by item size.
fields.keywords: return, 30 days, return policy, money back

fields.question: How do I start a return?
fields.answer: Go to Orders → select order → click Return. Choose reason (damaged, defective, wrong item, not as described). Provide details and submit.
fields.keywords: return, start return, initiate return, return process

fields.question: What can I return? What cannot be returned?
fields.answer: Can return: Most items unopened/unused. Cannot return: Food, consumables, personal items, used items, items without proper packaging.
fields.keywords: non-returnable, not returnable, cannot return, refundable

fields.question: How long does return processing take?
fields.answer: After seller receives return, they have 3-5 days to inspect. Upon approval, refund issued. Total time: 7-10 days from return date.
fields.keywords: return time, processing time, how long

fields.question: What about warranty?
fields.answer: Warranty depends on product. Electronics typically 12 months. Check product page for details. Warranty covers manufacturing defects only.

fields.question: How does quality verification work?
fields.answer: All sellers are verified for reliability. Products are checked for accuracy. Our AI reviews customer feedback. Low-rated sellers may be removed.
fields.keywords: quality, verified, quality check, seller verification

fields.question: How do I add multiple addresses?
fields.answer: In Profile → Addresses, click "Add New Address". You can add unlimited addresses (home, office, etc.) for quick checkout.

fields.question: Is my data safe with RootReach?
fields.answer: Yes! We use encryption, secure servers, and follow data protection laws. Your data is never shared without permission.
fields.keywords: data security, privacy, data protection, safe

fields.question: How do I enable 2-factor authentication?
fields.answer: Go to Account Settings → Security → Enable 2FA. We'll send verification code to your phone with each login for extra security.

fields.question: Can I delete my account?
fields.answer: Yes, but accounts with pending orders cannot be deleted. Complete all orders first, then request deletion from Settings → Account → Delete Account.
fields.keywords: delete account, close account, remove account

fields.question: How do I improve product visibility?
fields.answer: Use clear titles with keywords, detailed descriptions, high-quality 3-4 photos, correct category, competitive pricing, and regular updates.

fields.question: What is the best product description?
fields.answer: Include: what it is, features, specifications, material, dimensions, color options, ideal for (use cases). Be honest and detailed. Use simple language.

fields.question: How should I price my products?
fields.answer: Research similar products on RootReach. Consider costs, profit margin (20-100% typical), market demand, and competition. Competitive pricing sells faster.

fields.question: How do I handle difficult customers?
fields.answer: Stay professional and friendly. Listen to concerns. Offer solutions (replacement, partial refund, etc.). Document everything. Escalate to support if needed.
fields.keywords: customer service, complaint, difficult buyer, conflict

fields.question: How often should I update my products?
fields.answer: Update prices and stock regularly (weekly). Add seasonal items, refresh photos, update descriptions. Active sellers rank higher! Update at least weekly.

fields.question: Should I offer discounts?

fields.question: Why is my account locked?
